content: Mandoŋo nsaama
Ya me áangyughu likyi lili mpini li lífi ku ebini kii ngili li líkalyele kundaa bangye-yulu nsaama ti: Ligye, litsala ŋa yulu a nsie mandoŋo nsaama mama nkehe a Nzaami.
Ngye-yulu wu a nsomo ágyene ya átsala ndoŋo a nde ŋa yulu a nsie. Baara ba báli a elyimi kii nyama ya ba bákasamana efaana e nyama munde bábagha biboŋo bi biikakolo ku olagha.
Ngye-yulu wu a buolo átsala ndoŋo a nde ŋa yulu a mubu, ŋaana oŋo mubu ákighiri makili ti anga makili ma mbwuru wu ákpi, ya bibuo byehene bibi mweẽ bi bíli mu mubu bíkpi.
Ngye-yulu wu batere átsala ndoŋo a nde ŋa yulu a manzala ya mikele mi madza, ya madza mwohono mákighiri makili.
Me áangyughu ngye-yulu wuli a litumu ŋa yulu madza ákalyele ti:

content.text: We li wu a nsumu, we wu li ya we wu áali, we Wu a Ngili,
Buulu bo baatsala makili ma ba bangili ya mama mibighili,
we aagwi bo makili mpaala baŋma,

content: Ya me áangyughu ebini ki baakatsughu malyimi mama mpihi élyele ti:

content.text: ndandamana a we yili yi a ngaŋma ya yi a nsumu!

content: Ngye-yulu wu bana átsala ndoŋo a nde ŋa yulu a tala. Bágwi tala muswa mu otsughu baara mu mbaa.
Ya baara bádzighi mu kyaŋana kii mpini. Bo bábwi otsaala nkwumu a Nzaami wu li a lileene ŋa yulu a biwa bibye. Ya bo bábihi ogyiŋi mayele mu ogwa nde nsia.
Ngye-yulu wu bataana átsala ndoŋo a nde ŋa yulu a likubu li nyama. Empu e nde ésomo kunsa mpyibi. Baara bákatswa manzalisogho myini mu nkooro a mpara.
Bo bákatsaala Nzaami wu a ku mayulu mu nkooro a mpara ya mu nkooro a biboŋo, lo bo ka bágyiŋi mayele mu bigyighili bi bo o.
Ngye-yulu wu basemene átsala ndoŋo a nde ŋa yulu a Efarate, nzala yi nene. Madza ma nzala mákee mu odzubulu nzili kundaa mikogho mi miikafa ku ookapala tala.
Ŋa mbihi oŋo, me áamono mifulu mitere mi misuŋumu mi mifaana ti madzughu, mi mípala mu muŋma a ndarango, mu muŋma a nyama, ya mu muŋma a mubighili wu a mpya.

Mye mili mifulu mi mibi mimi Satana, mi miikasa bilyimi bibi okiŋimi ya miikagye kundaa mikogho mi nsie nsyini, mu kuulu mibvughu mye emõ mu odzwana mvulu yi a etsughu ki enene kii Nzaami, Nga-a-Mpwũ.
Mono, me ndi mu ogya ti nga-a-pfyibi. Esee kundaa munde wu aakahala mihi ya wu aakakebe binkuru bi nde mpaala anyaã ogye mpene ya baara banyaã omono mpene a nde.
Mifulu mimi bi mi mye, bábvughu mye ŋa ebini ki baakata mu eebele ti Aramangedõ.
Ŋa nseele ngye-yulu wu a nsaama átsala ndoŋo a nde mu yulu. Mu ebini kii ngili, likyi lili mpini lípala, lo lífi ŋa likubu ya lílyele ti: Oofi!
Mu obo, óli a misehene, nkyi, banganzele ya munyiĩ a nsie wu munene, wuulu obaana bu oli baara ŋa yulu a nsie, nkini ka bámaamono nsie mu onyiĩ obo o.
Bvulu li linene líkaghaba mu bipa bitere. Mabvulu mama mansie mábwi ya Nzaami álibili mweẽ mu Babilone li Linene, mpaala agwa lo ndoŋo a bviini a nkehe a nde yi nene.
Bilyi byehene bíbara, ya minguo mídzimini.
Mvulu wu makele ma manene, mama leme lili ku bele a bakilo makwumu-matere (30) ánoõ ŋa yulu a baara, ya bo bátsaala Nzaami mu nkooro a ewa kii mvulu wu makele, mu kuulu ewa ekye éli nkara ki enene.
